summary_en: The company raised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending February 2027 to 36 yen per share from 33 yen, adding a 3 yen special anniversary dividend to the ordinary 17 yen final dividend, alongside the 16 yen interim dividend already paid.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Implementation of Centennial Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Onward Holdings announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending February 2027. The company increased the full-year dividend to 36 yen per share from the previously forecast 33 yen per share. The interim dividend remains 16 yen per share, while the final dividend has been raised from 17 yen to 20 yen per share, comprising 17 yen in ordinary dividend and 3 yen in special commemorative dividend.

The company noted that it reaches its 100th anniversary in 2027, having been founded as Kashiyama Shouten in 1927. The board of directors approved the dividend increase to express gratitude to shareholders and other stakeholders for their long-standing support through the company's century of operations. The special 3 yen dividend is a one-time commemoration of this milestone.
